description: List the builtin style presets, show one resolved style (builtin id or a .style.json path with its extends chain), export a family palette as .mcpx, or write a new .style.json document. Style files are read-only inputs except for create and export-palette, which write only their explicit output path.

baselinePath.description: audit only: baseline member, defaults to the first input.

category.description: lint only: item category id, so its threshold overrides apply; omitted means category-scoped rules do not run.

extends.description: create only: builtin id or .style.json path to inherit; defaults to vanilla.

family.description: export-palette only: family id, or all for every family.

force.description: Replace an existing output file as a whole (export-palette and create).

inputPath.description: lint only: raster image path to measure and check; read only, never written.

inputPaths.description: audit only: texture paths in audit order.

mode.description: Style subcommand: list, show, export-palette, create, lint, or audit.

name.description: create only: display name; defaults to the id.

outputMcpxPath.description: export-palette only: explicit .mcpx output path. When omitted the palette text returns in the result and nothing is written.

overrides.description: create only: style sections merged into the new document, for example {"limits":{"maxColors":12}}.

paths.description: list only: custom .style.json paths to report alongside the builtin presets; each one loads or is reported as unreadable.

style.description: show and export-palette: builtin style id or a .style.json path.

name: style_asset
